blind.description: An architectural wall corbel or shelf bracket designed with a gothic fantasy motif. It features a right-angled stone support frame with a flat rectangular top ledge inlaid with dark purple. Underneath the shelf, nestled within the bracket, is a stylized sculpted spider with lavender and white markings, visible legs, and head details. The frame is finished in pale stone with carved trim. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylised.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular ledge with a dark purple inset and pale stone border, with lavender spider legs visibly protruding from the sides beneath it.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall, roughly slightly under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide/deep.
